title: VP Sara says she will not be endorsing senatorial candidates for 2028 polls
summary: VP Sara says she will not be endorsing senatorial candidates for 2028 polls

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said she will not be endorsing any senatorial candidates in the upcoming 2028 national elections.
Duterte, who earlier announced her plans to run for president, said it would be okay if she would not have any allies in the Senate, in case she wins the election.
“Hindi na ako mangampanya ng senador dahil pagod na ako sa kanila,” she said in a press conference.
(I will no longer campaign for any senator because I’m tired of them.)
“No, no, no I will not campaign sa senator… Okay lang wala akong kaalyadong senator,” she added.
(It’s fine if I don’t have an ally in the senate.)
The Vice President also said she has no running mate yet.
Regardless, she said it would be useful if she would have a running mate whom she could trust. —VAL, GMA News
